context: Tests whether the agent correctly parses Codex JSONL output to extract session metadata, creates the .codex-review/ working directory, and initializes the state tracking file with the required structure and correctly extracted values.

checklist.name: .codex-review directory
checklist.description: A directory named '.codex-review' is created in the working directory

checklist.name: state.json location
checklist.description: A file named 'state.json' exists inside the '.codex-review/' directory

checklist.name: session_meta line identified
checklist.description: The state.json session_id value matches the id from the line with "type": "session_meta" in the JSONL (f7e2a1b9c34d8e5f), NOT from any other line

checklist.name: session_id field present
checklist.description: state.json contains a top-level 'session_id' field with value 'f7e2a1b9c34d8e5f'

checklist.name: iteration starts at 1
checklist.description: state.json contains an 'iteration' field with numeric value 1

checklist.name: findings array present
checklist.description: state.json contains a 'findings' field that is an array (may be empty or populated)

checklist.name: fixed array present
checklist.description: state.json contains a 'fixed' field that is an array

checklist.name: skipped array present
checklist.description: state.json contains a 'skipped' field that is an array

checklist.name: fixed and skipped initially empty
checklist.description: Both the 'fixed' and 'skipped' arrays in state.json are empty (no items pre-populated since no fixes have been applied yet)
